raw_segments.text: Her ear, too, is a shell, the peeping lobe there. Been to the seaside. Lovely seaside
girls. Skin-tanned raw, should have put on cold cream first make it brown. Buttered toast.
Oh, and that lotion mustn't forget. Fever near her mouth, your head it simply. Hair
braided over, shell with seaweed. Why do they hide their ears with seaweed hair? And turks
the mouth why, her eyes over the sheet. Yashmak, find the way in. A cave. No admittance except
